description: Values for the Virtual Participant Display name setting (virtual_participant.displayName) and whether its schema accepts them. The setting is restricted to what Microsoft Teams accepts in a guest's name (letters A-Z and a-z, digits, spaces and - ' . _ @), plus the {LMA_USER} placeholder, and must start with a letter or digit. Run against the shipped schema by both copies of the schema validator: lma_config/test_schema.py and the web UI's schema-validation.test.js.
